ACCESSIBILITY STRESS TEST — EXPECTED RESULTS

UPLOAD SETTINGS
- Turn ON heading detection and high-contrast correction.
- Keep the all-tables-have-header-rows checkbox OFF. Some tables are layout tables.
- Turn ON tagged PDF export if LibreOffice is installed.

EXPECTED AUTOMATIC FIXES
- Make supported editable text black on white, including white/invisible, gray, yellow, blue, highlighted, dark-background, table, header, footer and hyperlink text.
- Remove highlight backgrounds and underline hyperlinks.
- Add likely section heading styles and missing document title/default-language metadata.
- Export Word, HTML text, and (if available) a tagged PDF.

EXPECTED REPORT FINDINGS
- Small source text (7, 8 and 9 points); with the new minimum-text option enabled the app raises supported text to 12 points and records the correction.
- Skipped heading levels (Heading 3 and Heading 4).
- Two graphics without alt text.
- Four tables without designated header rows; merged cells in two layout tables.
- Vague click here/read more/here link labels.
- Explicit light text colors below 4.5:1 against white.

HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED — NOT AUTOMATIC FIXES
- Add accurate image descriptions using the supplied chart values.
- Correct heading levels and designate headers for actual data tables individually. Simplify merged layout tables.
- Enlarge small text. Replace vague link labels with meaningful destinations. Links point to example.com placeholders.
- Replace color-only approval instructions with explicit status words; black/white conversion removes their visual distinction.
- Replace position/shape-only instructions with explicit names.
- Convert typed numbered paragraphs into a real Word list.
- Mark the French passage as French and explain abbreviations.
- Review every applicable WCAG criterion. Listing a criterion does not mean the app tested or passed it.

EXPORT LIMITATIONS
- HTML is a text export; it omits graphics, headers/footers, and hyperlink destinations.
- A tagged PDF still needs validation and review of reading order, tables and alt text.
- This is fictional test content. Do not treat the converted result as certified accessible.

VERIFIED HERE
The current app corrected editable text colors and retained both images and all four tables. Its report included the expected contrast, small-text, heading, alt-text, table and link findings. Microsoft Word rendering and its Accessibility Checker were not run.

CURRENT GUIDED WORKFLOW
After processing, choose Review and correct remaining issues. Supply chart alt text, confirm heading levels, designate headers for the two real data tables, and simplify layout tables only after reviewing the preview. Replace vague link wording using the destination. Apply corrections to regenerate downloads, then inspect the actual Word/PDF outputs.
